phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Qisqa muddatli mahalliy ish, shartli ozod qilish shartlarini ofitseringiz bilan tekshiring, telefon raqamlari hech qachon ko'rsatilmaydi.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Jamg'arma maqsadlari va uy-joyga tayyorlik rejasi. Groundwork uy-joyni ta'minlamaydi va provayderlar bilan hamkorlik qilmaydi. Mahalliy yordam uchun 211-ga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: To'lov rejasi. Hali narx belgilab qo'yilmagan.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Ushbu raqamlarni hozir saqlang. Shuningdek, har qanday ekranning yuqori qismida yordam kerakligini bosishingiz mumkin.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Har bir sud sanasi va roʻyxatga olishni taqvimga qoʻying

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Medicaid-ga ro'yxatdan o'ting va agar kerak bo'lsa SNAP

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Yashash uchun xavfsiz joy toping (211 raqamiga yoki mahalliy uy-joy resurslariga qo'ng'iroq qiling)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Ushbu hafta uchun oziq-ovqat toping (211 yoki mahalliy oziq-ovqat xonasiga qoʻngʻiroq qiling)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Ko'rib chiqish uchun loyihalashtiring. Chiziqdan so'ng birinchi 24 soat davomida birinchi qadamlar bu erda ko'rsatiladi. Siz yolg'iz emassiz.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Hujjatlaringiz shifrlangan. To'lov rejasi xususiyati; hali narx belgilab qo'yilmagan.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Siz yolg'iz emassiz. Yuqoridagi inqiroz tugmasi har doim bu erda  —  chaqiring yoki xabar yuboring 988, yoki favqulodda vaziyatda 911.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Ariza berishdan oldin shartli yoki sinov muddati shartlarini ofitseringiz bilan tekshiring.
